prompt: Some people say that in the digital age, theatres and cinemas are no longer important as people can watch all the entertainment they want online. Others argue that theatres and cinemas are Still important both economically and culturally. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, it is clear that many people are debating with the idea of the age for starting to use digital materials, theatres , culture and cinemas are no longer important because everyone has the option to watch everything they want on their phone, whilst others still value the importance of theatres and cinemas for the economy and the culture of the country.

On one hand, it is true that a large part of the population agrees with the facility and the simple access that we have to discover everything we are looking for on our phone or computer without having a financial cost, or losing time going to the cinema or theatre, as well. For example, a survey conducted by the University of Lisbon and published by the famous Scientific Journal, in 2024, proves that 90% of the population agrees with the progress of online access , offering the possibility to watch movies and theatrical scenes.

On the other hand, many citizens agree that it is important to take into account the culture of the country and the history that is represented in many typical movies, or comedies , but also in theatrical scenes. While I agree that cinemas and theatres are essential for our society and for our future. In addition, a large variety of people are looking for typical movies that they can watch in a comfortable place, other than their home. For instance, in the United States, the government has established some rules to offer the opportunity to go to the cinema for free, one day a week.

To conclude, although many people believe that online access to everything is important, I believe that physical cultural places and areas are fundamental for our society and for our future.
